title: void.growth.json
description: How Void has grown: an append-only ledger, one entry per change to what Void can do. Append with node tools/grow.mjs; summon on the surface with "growth".

by.description: Who: the agent or person's slug (claude, grok, forethinkers, adam).

kind.description: grow: a new thing Void can do. build: an improvement to one. fix: something broken now works. retire: something removed or folded into Void. idea / finding: from the idea stream, not yet built.

ref.description: Optional link: the PR, commit or page.

from.description: Optional: where a backfilled entry was copied from.
